en.nf_text: We could not find that page. It may have moved, or perhaps we never had it.
en.services_intro: Prices are a guide; we are always happy to talk through what you need.
en.contact_intro: Drop in during opening hours or give us a call. We are happy to talk through what you need before you decide anything.
en.contact_note: Parking is easiest on the next street along. If the door is closed during opening hours, we are probably on the phone; knock and wait a moment.

bundles.desc: A neighbourhood bakery in {city}: sourdough, rolls and cakes, baked every morning.
bundles.desc_services: Breads, buns and cakes, with prices.
bundles.desc_about: The story of {brand}, a small bakery in {city}.
bundles.desc_contact: Opening hours and address of {brand} in {city}.
bundles.intro: A small neighbourhood bakery. Sourdough, rolls and cakes, baked every morning before the shop opens.

features.p: Cakes and larger orders by arrangement.

services.d: Slowly risen, with a thick crust and a soft, open crumb.
Dense, dark and very good with cheese.
Soft rolls, baked at five and usually gone by ten.
Twisted by hand and glazed while still warm.
Please order three days ahead; we will agree the flavours with you.

about: {brand} began in a rented kitchen behind a shop in {city}, with one oven and a good deal of optimism.
We still bake in small batches, with flour from a mill an hour down the valley and a sourdough starter that is older than our youngest baker.
Come early for the rolls, stay for the coffee, and tell us if your loaf was not right. We would rather know.

bundles.desc: Bicycle repairs and servicing in {city}, done while you wait or by the next day.
bundles.desc_services: Repairs and servicing for bicycles, with prices.
bundles.desc_about: About {brand}, a small bicycle workshop in {city}.
bundles.desc_contact: Opening hours and address of {brand} in {city}.
bundles.intro: A small workshop for everyday bicycles. We fix what is broken, adjust what is not quite right and tell you honestly what is not worth the money.

features.p: Most small repairs take less than an hour.
We will say so if something is not worth fixing.
Drop it off in the morning, collect it tomorrow.

services.d: Inner tube fitted and checked, tyre inspected for the culprit.
Brakes and gears adjusted, chain cleaned and oiled, tyres and bolts checked.
Strip-down, degrease and rebuild of drivetrain, with new cables where needed.
Wobbles taken out and spoke tension evened up.
Lights, brakes, tyres and mudguards, so the dark months are less of a risk.

about: {brand} started in a garden shed in {city}, fixing neighbours' bicycles for the price of a coffee.
Today we have a proper workshop, a very long bench and a wall of spare parts that only we understand. We still prefer repairing to replacing.
Bring anything with two wheels. If we cannot fix it, we will tell you who can.

bundles.desc: Clothing alterations and repairs in {city}: hems, zips, fittings and mending.
bundles.desc_services: Alterations and repairs for clothes, with prices.
bundles.desc_about: About {brand}, a small tailoring workshop in {city}.
bundles.desc_contact: Opening hours and address of {brand} in {city}.
bundles.intro: Hems, zips, fittings and mending, done by hand and by machine in a small workshop above the shops.

features.p: Every garment is looked at properly before we start.
We pin it on you, not on a mannequin.
We give you a day and keep to it.

services.d: Hemmed to your length, with the original finish kept where possible.
Sides and sleeves adjusted so it hangs properly.
Matched for colour and weight, fitted neatly.
A torn lining replaced or repaired, pockets included.
Visible or invisible, as you prefer.

about: {brand} is a workshop of two on the first floor of a building in {city}, above a shop that sells wool.
We learnt the trade from people who had done it for forty years, and we have kept some of their habits, such as always pinning twice.
If you are not sure whether something is worth altering, bring it in. We will tell you honestly.

bundles.desc: Watch and clock repair in {city}: servicing, batteries, straps and restoration.
bundles.desc_services: Watch and clock repairs, with prices.
bundles.desc_about: About {brand}, a small watch and clock workshop in {city}.
bundles.desc_contact: Opening hours and address of {brand} in {city}.
bundles.intro: A small bench where watches and clocks are cleaned, adjusted and brought back to keeping good time.

features.p: Every movement is opened, cleaned and checked.
Servicing comes with a twelve month guarantee.
You are told the price before anything is touched.

services.d: Movement cleaned, oiled, regulated and timed over several days.
New battery fitted and the seal checked.
Mantel and wall clocks stripped, repaired and set going again.
Leather, fabric and metal straps fitted while you wait.
Gentle polishing of cases and bracelets, without removing character.

about: {brand} is a one-person bench in a corner of {city}, with a very good lamp and a drawer full of tiny screws.
Most of what comes in is inherited: a grandfather's watch, a clock from a mantelpiece. We try to mend it and keep it as it was.
We do not sell new watches. We just make the old ones go.

bundles.desc: Picture framing in {city}: mounts, glass, box frames and restoration.
bundles.desc_services: Framing, mounting and hanging, with prices.
bundles.desc_about: About {brand}, a small framing workshop in {city}.
bundles.desc_contact: Opening hours and address of {brand} in {city}.
bundles.intro: A framing workshop for prints, photographs, textiles and things that do not fit in a frame at all.

features.p: Every frame is cut and joined in our workshop.
We help you choose a mount and a moulding that suit the picture.
Available for work that should last.

services.d: A simple moulding, a mount and clear glass.
For posters and big prints, with lighter glazing.
Medals, shells, tickets and other small things worth keeping.
Repair, regilding and a new back.
We will bring the pictures and hang them straight.

about: {brand} is a small workshop in {city} that has been cutting mitres since long before anyone in the building was born.
We frame a lot of children's drawings and a few very old maps. Both get the same attention and the same acid-free card.
Bring us something you care about and we will find the frame it has been waiting for.

bundles.desc: Piano tuning, small repairs and advice in {city} and the surrounding villages.
bundles.desc_services: Piano tuning and repair services, with prices.
bundles.hero_h: A piano that sounds like one
bundles.intro: Tuning, small repairs and honest advice for upright and grand pianos in {city} and the villages around it.

features.p: Tuning is done where the piano lives.
A tuning takes as long as it needs to.
If a piano is not worth repairing, we will say so.

services.d: A standard tuning to concert pitch, about ninety minutes.
Tuning plus small adjustments to make the keys more even.
For pianos that have drifted flat after years without attention.
Sticking keys, loose pedals and buzzing strings.
A visit to look at a second-hand piano before you commit.

about: {brand} is one person with a case of tuning levers and an old estate car, covering {city} and the villages around it.
Most pianos I see have not been tuned in years and still sound better than their owners expect. A little patience does a lot.
I will tell you honestly what a piano needs and what it can do without.
hours: Visits: Monday to Saturday, by appointment
